source_text: Ταῦτα δὲ φημισθέντα, πάντες ἀπεθηριώθησαν εἰς ἡμᾶς, ὥστε καὶ εἴ τινες τὸ πρότερον δι᾽ οἰκειότητα ἐμετρίαζον, τότε μεγάλως ἐχαλέπαινον καὶ διεπρίοντο ἐφ᾽ ἡμῖν· ἐπληροῦτο δὲ τὸ ὑπὸ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν εἰρημένον ὅτι ἐλεύσεται καιρὸς ἐν ᾧ πᾶς ὁ ἀποκτείνας ὑμᾶς δόξει λατρείαν προσφέρειν τῷ θεῷ. Ἐνταῦθα λοιπὸν ὑπεράνω πάσης ἐξηγήσεως ὑπέμενον κολάσεις οἱ ἅγιοι μάρτυρες, φιλοτιμουμένου τοῦ σατανᾶ κἂν ἐξ ἐκείνων ῥηθῆναί τι τῶν βλασφήμων· ὑπερβεβλημένως δὲ ἐνέσκηψεν ἡ ὀργὴ πᾶσα καὶ ὄχλου καὶ ἡγεμόνος καὶ στρατιωτῶν εἰς Σάγκτον τὸν διάκονον ἀπὸ Βιέννης καὶ εἰς Μάτουρον, νεοφώτιστον μέν, ἀλλὰ γενναῖον ἀγωνιστήν, καὶ εἰς Ἄτταλον Περγαμηνὸν τῷ γένει, στῦλον καὶ ἑδραίωμα τῶν ἐνταῦθα ἀεὶ γεγονότα, καὶ εἰς Βλανδῖναν, δι᾽ ἧς ἐπέδειξεν ὁ Χριστὸς ὅτι τὰ παρὰ ἀνθρώποις εὐτελῆ καὶ ἀειδῆ καὶ εὐκαταφρόνητα φαινόμενα μεγάλης καταξιοῦται παρὰ θεῷ δόξης διὰ τὴν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἀγάπην τὴν ἐν δυνάμει δεικνυμένην καὶ μὴ ἐν εἴδει καυχωμένην.
thought_title: Rage turned beastlike and holy endurance under torture
orientation: After pagan slaves falsely accused Christians of forbidden feasts and unions, the letter describes the resulting fury and the tortures aimed at Sanctus, Maturus, Attalus and Blandina.
pass_a_gloss: And when these things had been rumored, all became like beasts against us, so that even if some before were moderate because of acquaintance, then they were greatly angry and gnashed in rage at us. And what was spoken by our Lord was being fulfilled, that a time will come in which everyone who kills you will suppose that he offers worship to God. Hereupon then the holy martyrs endured tortures beyond all description, since Satan was eagerly striving that even from them something of the blasphemous things be said. And beyond measure the whole wrath both of mob and of governor and of soldiers burst upon Sanctus the deacon from Vienne and upon Maturus, a newly enlightened man indeed but a noble contender, and upon Attalus a man from Pergamum by birth, who had always been a pillar and support of those here, and upon Blandina, through whom Christ showed that the things appearing among men to be cheap and shapeless and contemptible are counted worthy of great glory with God because of love toward him, love shown in power and not boasting in outward form.

Keeps the cutting or grinding force of fury directed at Christians rather than general anger

pass_b_english: When those slanders spread, everyone became like beasts against us. Even those who had held back before because of family ties now raged fiercely and gnashed in rage at us. In this, what our Lord had spoken was coming true: "A time will come when everyone who kills you will think he is offering worship to God" (John 16:2).

Then the holy martyrs endured torture beyond all description, since Satan was eagerly striving to draw even one of those blasphemies from their own mouths. The full fury of crowd, governor, and soldiers broke beyond all measure upon Sanctus, the deacon from Vienne, upon Maturus, newly baptized yet a brave contender, and upon Attalus, a man from Pergamum by birth who had always been a pillar and support for the Christians here, and upon Blandina. Through her Christ showed that what seems cheap and ugly and contemptible to people he counts worthy of great glory with God, when love for him is shown in power and does not boast in outward form.
